title: The AI Daily — Morning Conversation
blurb: An American-English dialogue limited to publisher feed excerpts.
lines: Hey, welcome to The AI Daily. I'm Maya, and Ben is here with me. We've picked a few headlines from publisher news feeds to talk through.
Hi, Maya. These are short feed excerpts, not the full articles, so we'll keep the facts carefully attributed and avoid filling in the blanks.
Let's start with The Decoder. The headline is: Hermes Agent's Collective Wisdom feature turns one employee's AI trick into the whole team's skill.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Companies will soon be able to run the open-source Hermes Agent from Nous Research directly inside Microsoft Teams.
That brings us to TechCrunch AI, which has this headline: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO.
According to the publisher's excerpt, At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.
Next up, LawSites reports: As ROSS Seeks to Come Back from the Dead, Clio Sues to Keep from Having to Resume Its Case Law Feed.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Ever since ROSS Intelligence shut down in 2021 under the weight of a copyright lawsuit by Thomson Reuters, I have…
And our fourth story is from Wired: This 16-Year-Old Founded an AI Missile Startup. He’s Targeting ‘Cost per Kill’.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Henrijs Dandzbergs dropped out of high school to join startup accelerator Y Combinator. With a new breed of missile, he…
Before we go, here's a useful expression: keep an eye on. It means watch something for changes — like a fast-moving AI story.
Exactly. And look into means investigate further. Follow the original reporting for context. See you in the next edition.
note: AI voices reading a conservative two-host script grounded only in publisher feed excerpts. Full article claims were not independently verified.
